clips.title: The story
paras: Deep in Gnomeregan, the Sparklematic 5200 still cleans what can be saved. The machine remained behind when the city was evacuated, and for a small silver fee it scrubs curiosities coated in muck and radioactive sludge.

Gnomeregan's engineers installed automated devices throughout the city before the trogg invasion and the fallout that followed. Toxic waste and hostile automatons now fill its corridors, yet the Sparklematic 5200 still follows its exact programming. It needs three silver coins and an artifact caked in grime to begin.

The Sparklematic lurches as it sprays and scrubs an inserted relic with potent gnomish solvents. A cheerful chime marks the end of the cycle, and the machine dispenses a neatly packaged box. Inside is whatever salvage remained beneath corrosive trogg slime and toxic filth.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The Sparklematic 5200 comes to life, lurching to and fro. Inside, the helpless grime that has encrusted the object placed within it is being pulverized by the machine's gnomish cleaning agent.
The Sparklematic 5200 comes to a halt, heralded by a familiar "ding!" The item receptacle of the machine spirals open, revealing a neatly wrapped box.
